description: Multi-venue PUBLIC quotes and trades (bitbank, GMO Coin, bitFlyer spot ticker), recorded continuously by scripts/record_venues.py for the effective-cost-floor / cross-venue lead-lag research line.
source: public REST: bitbank (/{pair}/ticker, /{pair}/transactions), GMO Coin (/ticker, /trades), bitFlyer (/v1/ticker) -- see scripts/record_venues.py
retention: not exchange-limited (recorder-owned, appended forward only); kept indefinitely once written, daily gz files, never regenerated in place

ts_utc.meaning: TRADE/QUOTE time reported by the exchange for that ticker snapshot (bitbank `timestamp` ms epoch, GMO `timestamp` ISO string, bitFlyer `timestamp` ISO string) -- verified against scripts/record_venues.py: this column is exchange time, not our own collection time, for every row currently written
ts_utc.notes: READ THIS BEFORE ASSUMING: docs/DATA_GOVERNANCE_PLAN.md's known-issues table warns of a `t`(collection time) vs `ts`(trade time) mixup specifically for 'venue execution files'. As of the current scripts/record_venues.py implementation there is no separate `t` column and `ts_utc` here is always exchange-sourced -- but this is exactly the kind of assumption that has been wrong before (see schema/bitflyer_tape.json's board_top5 entry for a live example of the same trap in a sibling dataset). Re-verify against the recorder code if the column ever looks suspiciously regular (a recorder that silently fell back to its own clock on a parse miss would look identical in the CSV).

pair.meaning: instrument symbol as the venue names it
pair.notes: not normalized across venues -- join on venue+pair, not pair alone

bid.unit: quote currency (mostly JPY; GMO altcoin pairs may quote in JPY or USDT depending on symbol)

last.meaning: last traded price reported by the ticker

ts_utc.meaning: trade execution time reported by the exchange
ts_utc.notes: same exchange-time caveat as quotes_*.csv.gz above

tid.notes: bitbank: exchange transaction_id (globally unique per pair). GMO: no id in the public trades response, so this is sha1(ts|price|size|side)[:16] -- two genuinely identical prints in the same source timestamp collapse into one row (documented, accepted, rare)

known_defects: GMO trade dedup uses a hash of (ts, price, size, side) because GMO's public trades carry no id -- a real double-print with identical values in the same timestamp is invisible as two trades
pair/symbol naming is venue-specific and not normalized (bitbank lowercase snake_case, GMO uppercase) -- do not string-match pair across venues without a mapping table

each stream backs off independently (interval * 2^failures, capped 5 min) on venue errors -- an outage on one venue does not stop others, but does mean per-venue row density can drop sharply for minutes without any error marker in the CSV itself; cross-check gaps against the recorder's stderr log if investigating a specific hole
GMO's ticker call returns ALL symbols per request; a symbol GMO delists or renames simply stops appearing, it is not marked 'missing' anywhere in this file
